description: This file defines the ConceptAnswerEditor class, which extends OpenmrsPropertyEditor<ConceptAnswer>. It provides methods for serializing and deserializing ConceptAnswer objects by ID and UUID, facilitating data binding in web forms within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: ConceptAnswerEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting between ConceptAnswer objects and their string representations for web forms.

methods.description: Default constructor for the ConceptAnswerEditor class.

methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptAnswer object by its UUID using the ConceptService.
